key_facts: Adj op margin 10%, a quarter ahead of plan
Stock down ~40% past month prior to report

headline: CoreWeave Raises Full-Year 2026 Guidance After Q3 Beat; Expects $9B in Customer Prepayments

~$9B in customer prepayments expected next 3 months

headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Spikes as Inflation Spreads across Economy, Driven by Ugly Core Services CPI
summary: October 2026 CPI came in hotter than expected at +0.4% month-over-month (forecast +0.3%), with core CPI at +0.3% m/m (forecast +0.2%). The data drove a sharp bond selloff, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield above 5% for the first time since earlier in 2026.
key_facts: 10-year yield jumped 12 bps on the day
Traders moved toward December rate hike
Fed Governor Waller comments added pressure

headline: 10-year Treasury yield races back to 5% as inflation data, Waller comments drive rate hike expectations
summary: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield climbed to nearly 5% on November 10 after hotter-than-expected October CPI and hawkish comments from Fed Governor Waller. The yield closed at approximately 4.99%, up 12 basis points on the session, with a weak 10-year note auction adding to selling pressure.
key_facts: Weakest 10-year auction demand since early June
Bond market closed Nov 11 for Veterans Day

headline: Market Quick Take: US Treasury yields rip higher — traders fully price December rate hike
summary: Traders fully priced in a December Federal Reserve rate hike following the hot October CPI data, with two more hikes expected by next June. The Federal Reserve's effective fed funds rate stood at 3.88% as of November 10. The 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.99% on Nov 10.
key_facts: December rate hike fully priced by markets
Two more hikes expected by June 2027
Fed funds rate 3.88% as of Nov 10

headline: Dollar Index Hits 18-Month High Above 103 as Hot CPI Lifts Fed Hike Bets
summary: The U.S. Dollar Index (DXY) hit an 18-month high of 103.08 on November 12 before retreating slightly to ~102.90 during European trading. The dollar's advance is driven by rising Fed rate hike expectations following the hot October CPI print and Fed Governor Waller's hawkish comments.
key_facts: DXY intraday high 103.08 on Nov 12 (18-month high)
Strength driven by rate hike bets and hot CPI

headline: Euro finds temporary support near 1.1066 against US Dollar; 18-month low
summary: EUR/USD dropped to a fresh 18-month low near 1.1066 on November 12 as the strong dollar weighed on the euro. The pair fell 0.65% to $1.11 on November 11 to its weakest since May 2025, and was trading around 1.1090 during European hours on Nov 12.

headline: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Enters fresh upside leg; trading at 159.65, near two-month high
summary: USD/JPY rose to ~159.65 on November 12, near a two-month high of 159.94 set on November 11, as the strong dollar and rising U.S. yields pressured the yen. Market participants are watching for potential Japanese government intervention near the 160.00 level.

headline: Asia-Pacific markets fall on Nvidia-related tech weakness; Nikkei -0.70%, Hang Seng -1.43%
summary: Asia-Pacific markets fell on November 11 as Nvidia-related tech sector weakness weighed on regional indices. Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 0.70% to 60,819.36, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng was down 1.43% and mainland China's CSI 300 dropped 0.78% to 4,043.93. South Korea's Kospi fell 0.61% and Australia's ASX 200 ended flat.

headline: European equities edge higher at open; Stoxx 600 +0.3%
summary: European stocks edged higher at the open on November 11, with the pan-European Stoxx 600 index adding approximately 0.3% shortly after the bell, partly decoupling from Asia's Nvidia-linked tech weakness.

headline: AMD Q3 2026 Earnings Beat: Revenue $13.38B +44.7% YoY, Data Center Doubles, Strong Q4 Outlook
summary: AMD reported Q3 2026 revenue of $13.38 billion, up 44.7% year-over-year and above the $13.08 billion consensus. Data Center revenue roughly doubled. Q4 2026 guidance was approximately $17 billion ±3%, well above expectations.

Stock closed $552.90 on Nov 11, +36.99% since Nov 6 rebound

OPEC+ core members ~5M bpd below prewar levels

headline: OPEC+ keeps December oil output targets steady as Iran war disrupts flows
summary: OPEC+ kept its December production targets unchanged at approximately 31 million barrels per day for the seven core members, the same level as September through November. The decision is partly symbolic as the Iran war has already reduced actual output by approximately 5 million bpd versus prewar levels.
key_facts: OPEC+ December targets unchanged at ~31M bpd
Third straight month at same level
Core members ~5M bpd below prewar levels due to Iran war
OPEC+ full meeting set for Nov 29 to set 2027 framework

headline: Strait of Hormuz Effectively Shut Since US-Israel Iran Attack; OPEC+ Members 5M bpd Below Prewar
summary: The Strait of Hormuz, which previously carried approximately 20% of global crude oil and LNG, has been effectively shut since the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran in late February 2026. OPEC+ core members are pumping approximately 5 million barrels per day below prewar levels as a result.
key_facts: Hormuz shut since ~Feb 28, 2026 (US-Israel attack on Iran)
Hormuz previously carried ~20% of world crude and LNG
